author.name: Paulo Freire
author.heading: About Paulo Freire
author.bio: Paulo Freire (1921–1997) was a Brazilian educator whose work connected literacy, dialogue and political participation. Best known for Pedagogy of the Oppressed, he treated education as a relationship in which learners actively interpret and change their world, rather than simply receive information.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The cited passage couples the limits of education with its necessity for social change. That distinction resists both the promise that schooling alone can solve social problems and the conclusion that education is irrelevant. The book belongs to Freire’s late reflections on education, freedom and authority, published in English after his death.
